privacyDescription.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Allow access to Bluetooth to search nearby Bluetooth devices for network configuration
privacyDescription.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Allow access to Bluetooth to search nearby Bluetooth devices for network configuration
privacyDescription.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow access to your camera to scan QR codes and bind devices
privacyDescription.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow access to your location to optimize device network signal recommendations
privacyDescription.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow access to your microphone to record audio and upload voiceprint information
privacyDescription.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access is required to select QR code images from your album for device binding

privacyDescription.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: ネットワーク設定のために近くのBluetoothデバイスを検索するには、Bluetoothへのアクセスを許可してください
